scope: Test fixtures and runner configuration only; published package source and optimization settings unchanged.
originalFailure: A real HTTPS relay server raced another package-root server while Vite removed their shared dependency cache (ENOTEMPTY). The mandatory pre-push hook stopped before push.

inventory.remainingSites: Unique OS temporary roots, outside ancestors with package.json; their default caches remain independent.

regression.test: keeps the first record when a second dev server for the same root stops
regression.before: 1 intended assertion failure: same root had the same cacheDir
regression.after: The full suite passes the distinct-cache assertion and existing relay-record/lifecycle assertions.

lifetime.ownership: One main-process temporary root provided through Vitest; every real shared-root server acquires a unique child directory.
lifetime.shutdown: Existing per-test awaited server.close callbacks are preserved. Root removal occurs synchronously at runner exit after worker disposal, with bounded Node filesystem retries and visible failure.
lifetime.reason: Vite cancellation does not await an already-running Rolldown bundle.write. Vitest global teardown precedes worker pool closure.
lifetime.rejectedControl: Per-test cache removal failed ENOTEMPTY; adding filesystem retries made tests green but the post-process inventory detected 21 recreated directories. That lifetime is not adopted.
lifetime.watch: The run-owned root stays alive across watch reruns until the runner exits.

notClaimed: No whole-workspace hook pass is inferred from this focused repair.
Normal mandatory pre-push and fresh remote required checks remain separate gates.
